title: signal/1: one aggregated usage count for a cell of the gap report. Counts only: no learner, device, session, time of day or free text can be recorded

period.description: an ISO week or a month; never a day

kind.description: request: a harness looked for content for this cell; miss: it found none it could serve

count.description: at least 20: smaller counts are not reported, so a count can never point at one learner

source.description: the public handle of the harness or product that sent it
